Включите {pgss} для статистики запросов: Enable {pgss} for query statistics and {autoexplain} (JSON format) for execution plans. pgmetrics takes plans, deadlocks and autovacuum runs from the log, which it reads only when it runs on the database host over a local connection; {logfile} only sets the file path. The log can be in stderr or csvlog format, but PostgreSQL 13+ csvlog is read only by the pgmetrics that pgscope builds ({build}, or the one in the agent image): official pgmetrics releases skip such files. For RDS and Aurora, add {rds} to collect CloudWatch metrics and the log through the RDS API.
